principle: Every model is profiled and frozen before the plans it predicts are executed; no target-plan timing is used to calibrate its own prediction. Reused experiments keep their original protocols.

experiment_A1_main.purpose: fixed-rho vs measured fusion retention, uninstrumented
experiment_A1_main.cells: U and F at K in {1,4,16,64}
experiment_A1_main.pins: driver CPU 12, all remote actors CPU 8, one thread each
experiment_A1_main.stop_rule: fixed at three rounds; no extra rounds added for results

experiment_A_instrumented.cells: U and F at the same K, plus P at K=16
experiment_A_instrumented.instrumentation: per-member wall and CPU timing enabled

synthetic_anchor_profile.purpose: independent isolated compute anchor per K
synthetic_anchor_profile.actor: single remote Ray actor, CPU pin, one thread
